risk: P2: existing personal view presentation, no business writes or server permission changes

contracts.schema: Existing profile store v2 is retained; optional data.__viewVersion=1 decorates the legacy layout. Future unsupported view versions are ignored. No parallel profile endpoint.
contracts.columns: Exact stable local bindings take precedence. Missing bindings map only through unique canonical IDs; ambiguous and removed columns are dropped. New default columns use existing insertion behavior.
contracts.filters: Bundled filters use the existing native filter adapters. Current column/select IDs are allowlisted. Separately configured startup favourite filters retain precedence, followed by the current-user transient resume.
contracts.context: Active and anchor bindings contain user/workspace/row owner/source ID/canonical model tuple. Missing, filtered, replaced and foreign user/workspace records cannot change active selection. The existing table-range controller locates the matching page; numeric row position is not trusted.
contracts.resume: Bounded 200k-character local per-user preference; no HTTP or hidden module initialization. Explicit module query takes precedence. Existing switchTab checks current permission and falls back to Overview.
contracts.reset: Native picker clearing helper was absent and caused a live ReferenceError; added a regression and fixed view/filter default reset. Density/sorting reset in the existing path.
contracts.sharing: Existing server preview/merge/replace/undo UI retained. Shared columns/filters may apply, but row context remains bound to its original user/workspace.

independentReview.reason: Local P2 presentation-only feature; server authority, business state and sync protocols unchanged.

limits: Actual Edge acceptance at 1440×960 with synthetic records; actual Electron 200% remains BL019.
Share preview UI was inspected without importing a foreign live workspace; transfer/undo remain covered by existing targeted preset-share tests.
Final integrated full, current-head CI and batch GitHub merge remain pending.
